summary: Submission package referenced manufactured per-agent criteria artifacts (stage3/, marked status: draft) instead of the real agent definition files from IES root agents/; David: the actual agent files must be in the submission's agents/ folder, the manufactured ones will fail the grader.
context: Reviewing projects/stage-5-submission/: the stage3/ folder holds 11 manufactured criteria artifacts (status: draft in frontmatter), cited in index.md criterion 5 and submission-draft.md as agent evidence. The submission's agents/ folder only has manifest.md and adversarial-isolation.md, not the real per-agent definition files that live at IES root agents/.
correction: Submission evidence for agent criteria must be the real agent files from agents/ copied into the submission's agents/ folder, not manufactured summaries. Never present draft/synthesized artifacts as the primary evidence when the real files exist.
resolution: Copied the 11 real agent definition files from agents/ into projects/stage-5-submission/agents/ (staged via ies-git). Removed the manufactured stage3/ folder and stage3-compliance-plan.md / stage3-remediation-plan.md from the submission (git rm). Updated index.md, submission-draft.md, and README.md to cite agents/*.md as the evidence. The CHANGELOG line referencing systems/eval-harness/stage3/ is historical text pointing at the live repo path and was left as-is.
